verdict.rationale: Superhuman is built as a proxy layer on top of Gmail/Outlook (docs-12, docs-40) with no evidence of native IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access or standards-based export; probes for API/openapi specs return 404s and no documentation mentions protocol-level access or data export/portability. Community evidence raises concerns about vendor lock-in risk after acquisition (comm-4) but does not confirm or deny protocol openness. missing for 10: any documentation of IMAP/JMAP/SMTP support, any standards-based export/portability tooling, evidence contradicting or confirming open-protocol access.
